title: Iron Verdict
description: Production monitoring for Iron Verdict (#133). Import guide: docs/monitoring.md.

panels.title: Scrape
panels.description: 1 = Grafana reaches /metrics. 0 for 3 minutes fires the critical alert.

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Sessions in memory (generic + VPortal). Critical alerts only apply while > 0.

panels.title: Snapshot age
panels.description: Seconds since the last snapshot check that left the file up to date. Normally below about 2½ min (set every minute, scraped every minute).

panels.title: What stands out now
panels.description: Every alert rule that is firing or pending: critical (also sent to Telegram) and warning (dashboard only).

panels.title: Votes per minute
panels.description: Stored votes and votes answered with vote_rejected, by code.

panels.title: Lost connections (per 5 min)
panels.description: client: closed by device/network; heartbeat_stale: half-open connection; heartbeat_send_failed; flood; replaced: judge reconnected while the old socket was still registered; error: handler exception. Single heartbeat drops are normal on venue Wi-Fi.

panels.title: Memory (RSS)
panels.description: Orange from 512 MB (a leak is building up), red from 3 GB (critical alert; the instance limit is 4 GB).

panels.title: HTTP responses (per 5 min)
panels.description: Includes rate-limit hits (429) and unknown session codes (404) in 4xx.

targets.legendFormat: log lines not sent to Loki

panels.title: VPortal failures (per 5 min)
panels.description: Proxy requests to VPortal that did not end in ok, by result, plus GraphQL retries after a stale connection. Login rejected = wrong credentials (usually a typo).

panels.title: VPortal upstream time
panels.description: Time the proxy waited for VPortal per request (login: both calls; GraphQL: including the retry). The upstream timeout is 5 s.

panels.title: Logs
panels.description: All log lines (JSON, without client IPs). Filter in Explore, e.g. by session code: see docs/monitoring.md, Logs.

panels.title: Max snapshot age
panels.description: Includes nights without sessions only if the app was restarted; check against the session panel.

panels.title: VPortal failures by result
panels.description: Proxy requests to VPortal that did not end in ok (login rejected = wrong credentials).

panels.title: VPortal GraphQL retries
panels.description: GraphQL calls retried after a transport error (stale pooled connection); usually followed by success.

panels.title: Warnings and errors by event
panels.description: Log lines with level warning, error or critical in the last 7 days, by event name (the JSON field message).

panels.title: Log lines not sent to Loki
panels.description: Lines dropped for Loki (queue full or push failed); stdout in Railway still has them.

panels.title: Memory over the week
panels.description: A steady climb across days without a restart points to a leak.

panels.title: Lost connections over the week (per hour)
Votes and sessions over the week
